title: Destiny's Choice
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji's consciousness fell completely into darkness, the fourth page of the Tianji Record burst forth with dazzling golden light—a complete version of the Tianji Record was slowly emerging in the Void, while that cold eye watching everything was awaiting the final move of the chess game.

text.content: The runes on the altar had blazed to their limit, the blood-red light shooting toward the heavens almost tearing apart the entire night sky. Chen Ji stood at the crossroads, watching the slender figure in the altar's center gradually becoming translucent—it was Chen Nian, his sister he had searched for seven full years.

Her lips were moving, though too far away to hear any sound, but Chen Ji read the lip movement clearly—don't. He bitterly smiled in his heart, you silly girl, brother searched for so long, how could I possibly abandon you?

dialogue.content: Chen Nian... watch my lips, listen carefully—

text.content: Chen Ji's voice seemed so insignificant amid the clamor of the ritual, but miraculously, Chen Nian on the altar heard him. Her eyes widened suddenly, tears welling in her eyes, and her lips trembled as she responded—don't! Don't do this!

The Tianji Record trembled within his mind, the seal on the fourth page loosening to its absolute limit. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul manifested in the Void, his form more faded than ever before, his aged face filled with complex emotions.

dialogue.content: Are you certain? The price this time is far heavier than you can imagine. Severing the connection to the Heavenly Fate Key requires the price of the Chen Family mark flowing in your bloodline.

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng's words struck like thunder, and Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record trembling wildly in his mind. This was the most consequential moment of choice since he had obtained the Tianji Record.

choices.text: Severing the connection with blood as the price
choices.description: Burn one's own Chen Family bloodline to completely sever Chen Nian's connection to the ritual. The price is never being a member of the Chen Family again.
choices.visible_cost: Losing the Chen Family bloodline mark
choices.risk_hint: Forever losing the bond with the family

dialogue.content: I am a Chen family member, my blood carries the Chen family mark. Then let it go—burn!

choices.description: Attempt to use the Tianji Record to find a method that doesn't require sacrificing bloodline, but time may not be enough.
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate will be severely overdrawn

text.content: The Tianji Record flipped rapidly, countless scenes flashing before Chen Ji's eyes—yet each one pointed to the same conclusion: there was no other method. Time was flying.

The seal on the fourth page of the Tianji Record shattered with a deafening roar, countless golden runes surged forth like a flood, forming a dazzling cocoon of light around Chen Ji. Those were the shackles of destiny, the prophetic chains the Chen family had borne for generations—and now, they were breaking.

dialogue.content: From now on, you are no longer my sister, you are merely a free woman—Chen Nian.

text.content: The moment the words fell, the altar erupted with a thunderous roar. Those blood-red threads wrapped around Chen Nian began to unravel one by one, dissolving into scattered specks of light that vanished into the night sky. And Chen Ji's body began a terrifying transformation at this very moment.

choice.prompt: The bloodline was burning, Chen Ji's body growing translucent, but he did not retreat.

choices.text: Sever completely, leave no room for contingencies
choices.description: Burn every last drop of bloodline power, ensuring the ritual completely collapses with no possibility of revival.
choices.visible_reward: The ritual can never be restarted

dialogue.content: Since we're doing this, let's do it thoroughly—burn all my bloodline!

text.content: The fourth page of the Tianji Record slowly unfurled, countless ancient characters flowing forth like water. Chen Ji saw a truth sealed for ten thousand years—Chen family bloodline belonged to the ancient prophetic race, guardians of the Tianji Record's complete inheritance through generations. And the Eye of Heavenly Dao precisely wanted to seize the Chen family's Heavenly Fate power through Chen Nian, this "Heavenly Fate Key," to reshape the order of heaven.

The complete contents of the fourth page exploded like thunder in the depths of the Tianji Record. The Eye of Heavenly Dao's scheme was far more profound than imagined—it had treated all generations of prophets as mere pieces, and the Tianji Record was merely one of its pieces spread across the mortal world. A ten-thousand-year layout, all for this very moment.

Chen Nian's body trembled violently, those blood-red threads completely dispersing. Her feet finally touched the altar's stone floor, her translucent skin regaining the color of flesh and blood. She blankly stared at her own hands, then abruptly looked up—her brother stood not far away, but his body had already begun to dissipate.

dialogue.content: Brother! What did you do! Your body... your body is disappearing!
Silly girl... I told you, I would come find you. Brother just... did what should have been done long ago.

text.content: Chen Ji felt his body becoming translucent piece by piece, bloodline burning, flesh dissolving, every inch of bone发出龟裂的声响. But his face held no pain, only an unprecedented calm. The Chen family bloodline had bound him for twenty years, and now, he could finally protect the person he wanted to protect in his own way.

dialogue.content: No! I don't want you to save me! Why are you doing this! You're my brother!

text.content: Chen Ji used his last ounce of strength to raise his hand, gently touching Chen Nian's cheek. That hand had become translucent, the starry sky visible through it, yet he still gently wiped away the tears on her face.

dialogue.content: Silly girl... being your brother is the luckiest thing in my life. Even if I lose the Chen family bloodline, I will always be your brother. This... will never change.

text.content: In the final moment before Chen Ji's consciousness was about to dissipate, the Tianji Record suddenly emitted a blinding golden light. The seal on the fourth page completely shattered, and a complete rune formation took shape around Chen Ji—the outline of the complete Tianji Record, slowly emerging from the Void.

Chen Nian clutched Chen Ji's gradually translucent body in terror, tears flowing unceasingly. She could feel her brother's life force rapidly draining away, like fine sand held in the palm, impossible to retain no matter what. The runes on the altar had completely dimmed, but her heart was more frightened than ever.

dialogue.content: Brother! Don't leave me! I finally found you! Please, don't...

text.content: Chen Ji's consciousness drifted in the darkness, Chen Nian's wailing his only concern. He wanted to respond to her, wanted to tell her not to cry, wanted to tell her brother was so happy to see her again—but his lips could no longer move. Before his last thread of consciousness dissipated, he saw his sister's tear-streaked face, the most beautiful scenery he had ever seen in this life.

The altar collapsed, dust filling the heavens. Chen Nian knelt in the ruins, holding the unconscious Chen Ji in her arms, tears dripping onto his face drop by drop. The Tianji Record floated above the two, golden light blazing brilliantly, the complete contents of the fourth page slowly revealing themselves. And behind that radiance, a massive existence composed of countless eyes was slowly opening from the Void—the Eye of Heavenly Dao, it had finally appeared.

That cold gaze pierced through the Void, as if the entire heavens and earth held their breath at this moment. Before Chen Ji's consciousness completely dissipated in the darkness, he heard Chen Nian's heart-wrenching cry—"Brother!" That wail penetrated the endless darkness, like a blade, brutally piercing into some corner of his soul.

In the last moment before losing consciousness, Chen Ji opened his eyes with his final trace of strength. In his blurred vision, he could only make out Chen Nian's face—that tear-streaked face. He wanted to say "don't cry," wanted to say "brother succeeded," but his lips only slightly trembled, ultimately unable to utter a single word. The sounds of the altar's collapse gradually faded in his ears, and that cold eye was patiently waiting...
